title: Avoid repeated empty startup recovery passes for retired-run journal custody
outcome: Startup recovery work that cannot select a readable binding does not schedule an empty recovery thread on every host tick, while exact unresolved journal custody and later supported recovery remain intact.
acceptance: A behavioral regression covers retired-run journal custody whose pending or unsettled reconciliation prevents automatic settlement; repeated startup ticks do not repeatedly spawn empty recovery passes, and the exact journal remains protected until a supported settlement applies.
